title: Netherlands Phase 1 – Building-level Energy Simulation Dataset

resources.name: energy_sim_nl_phase1
resources.title: Netherlands Phase 1 Building Energy Dataset

fields.name: id
fields.description: Incrementally generated id of this building in the DB

fields.name: size_class
fields.description: Size/morphology class of the building (SFH/TH/MFH/AB), derived from party-wall area and number of dwellings (BAG3D)

fields.name: tabula_key
fields.description: TABULA type key (building type x construction period), used to look up TABULA heat demand intensities

fields.name: construction_year
fields.description: Construction year of the building (BAG3D)

fields.name: refurbishment_state
fields.description: Individual refurbishment state of the building (1 = existing, 2 = usual refurbishment, 3 = advanced refurbishment) -- always set, never null: unlabelled buildings default to 1

fields.name: refurbishment_state_src
fields.description: Source of refurbishment_state: "ep-online" (derived from an individual EP-Online energy label) or "assumption" (conservative default for buildings without a label)

fields.name: living_area
fields.description: Conditioned reference floor area (TABULA A_C,ref), summed from pure-woonfunctie BAG verblijfsobjecten (VBO) of the building

fields.name: heat_demand_1
fields.description: Annual heat demand at refurbishment state 1 (existing), from TABULA x living_area

fields.name: heat_demand_2
fields.description: Annual heat demand at refurbishment state 2 (usual refurbishment), from TABULA x living_area

fields.name: heat_demand_3
fields.description: Annual heat demand at refurbishment state 3 (advanced refurbishment), from TABULA x living_area

fields.name: heat_demand
fields.description: Annual heat demand at the building's actual, individual refurbishment state (reads heat_demand_1/2/3 via refurbishment_state)

fields.name: heat_cluster_1
fields.description: Cluster-mean of heat_demand_1, assigned into the cluster bins fitted on heat_demand (no separate clustering fit; see heat_cluster)

fields.name: heat_cluster_2
fields.description: Cluster-mean of heat_demand_2, assigned into the cluster bins fitted on heat_demand

fields.name: heat_cluster_3
fields.description: Cluster-mean of heat_demand_3, assigned into the cluster bins fitted on heat_demand

fields.name: heat_cluster
fields.description: Cluster-mean annual heat demand at the building's actual refurbishment state (1-D k-means over heat_demand, per building type)

fields.name: heat_technology
fields.description: Heuristically assigned heating technology ("gas" / "district_heat" / "hp"), based on neighbourhood-level (wijk) CBS/Klimaatmonitor heating-installation shares

fields.name: elec_demand
fields.description: Annual electricity demand of the building, from CBS national consumption tables (construction-year class x household-size class x building type), scaled by dwelling count for MFH/AB

fields.name: elec_cluster
fields.description: Cluster-mean annual electricity demand (1-D k-means over elec_demand, per building type)

fields.name: roof_type
fields.description: Roof form of the building: "flat" (avg_tilt_deg < 10 deg) or "gabled", following the same convention as the NRW dataset

fields.name: roof_orientation
fields.description: Dominant roof orientation for PV siting: "south" if roof_area_south > 0, else "east-west" (the same distinction that decides whether a building's non-zero value ends up in roof_cluster_south or roof_cluster_eastwest; for flat roofs this is a side effect of the same comparison and does not carry the same physical meaning as for gabled roofs)

fields.name: roof_area_south
fields.description: Dominant south-facing roof area for gabled roofs (0 if the east/west side is dominant instead); not meaningful for flat roofs

fields.name: roof_area_eastwest
fields.description: Dominant east/west-facing roof area for gabled roofs (0 if the south side is dominant instead); not meaningful for flat roofs

fields.name: roof_cluster_south
fields.description: Cluster-mean roof area relevant for south-facing PV: for gabled roofs, the building's dominant south roof area; for flat roofs, the total roof area -- flat roofs have no meaningful orientation, so their cluster is stored here rather than in a separate field. 0 (not null) where the clustering did not reach a building

fields.name: roof_cluster_eastwest
fields.description: Cluster-mean roof area relevant for east/west-facing PV, for gabled roofs whose east/west area is dominant; 0 for flat roofs and for gabled roofs whose south side is dominant

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude of the building footprint centroid, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) -- stored as a plain float rather than a PostGIS geometry column, since the target OEP table does not support bounding-box spatial queries; spatial filtering is done sequentially on lon/lat instead

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude of the building footprint centroid, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) -- see lon

context.title: Energy Simulation Data – Netherlands Building Stock

sources.title: 3DBAG / BAG3D – 3D building model of the Netherlands
sources.description: LoD2.2 3D building models for all buildings in the Netherlands, derived from BAG footprints and AHN point clouds. Provides per-building roof geometry (facet tilt, azimuth, area) used to derive building type morphology inputs and roof-orientation area (north/east/south/west/total).

sources.title: BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen) – Verblijfsobjecten
authors: Kadaster (Landelijke Voorziening BAG), namens Ministerie van BZK
sources.description: Official Dutch building and address register. Provides gebruiksdoel (use function) and oppervlakte (usable floor area) per verblijfsobject (VBO), used to derive reference floor area and dwelling counts per building.

sourceLicenses.name: CC0-1.0
sourceLicenses.title: Publiek domein / CC0 1.0 -- free use, no restrictions
sourceLicenses.instruction: Free use, no restrictions. Provided by Kadaster (Landelijke Voorziening BAG) on behalf of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK). Accessed via PDOK; bulk retrieval via the BAG Geopackage/Extract is recommended for large-scale queries -- the individual WMS/WFS/API is not intended for bulk retrieval.

sources.title: TABULA – Typology Approach for Building Stock Energy Assessment
sources.description: TABULA building archetypes providing specific heat demand values (space heating and DHW) per building type, construction period, and refurbishment state (existing / usual refurbishment / advanced refurbishment), Netherlands sheet.

sourceLicenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
sourceLicenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
sourceLicenses.instruction: You are free to share and adapt the material for any purpose, even commercially, as long as you give appropriate credit.

sources.title: Klimaatmonitor – Isolatiekwaliteit woningen naar woningtype
sources.description: Municipality-level shares of dwellings per insulation-quality class (goed/redelijk/slecht), per dwelling type (Grondgebonden/Appartement), for five building components (roof, facade, floor, living-room window, bedroom window). Used, together with EP-Online, to derive an individual refurbishment state per building.

sourceLicenses.name: Publiek-domein
sourceLicenses.title: Publiek domein (data.overheid.nl) / Klimaatmonitor reuse terms
sourceLicenses.instruction: Public domain / free reuse with attribution. This is Klimaatmonitor's own published aggregate product (municipality x dwelling-type distributions); the underlying individual EP-Online labels it is computed from carry no open license, but Rijkswaterstaat as data controller publishes the aggregated indicator under these more permissive terms.

sources.title: EP-Online – Energielabel database (NTA 8800)
sources.description: Register of individual Dutch energy labels (NTA 8800), providing Gebouwtype (dwelling-form ground truth), GebruiksoppervlakteThermischeZone (thermal-zone floor area), and Energieklasse per address. Used both to validate the morphological building-type classification and reference area, and to assign an individual refurbishment state per labelled building.

sourceLicenses.name: RVO-API-ToS
sourceLicenses.title: RVO EP-Online API terms of service (personal API key)
sourceLicenses.instruction: Free use per RVO API-key terms of service, provided individual-level label data is not passed on to third parties in bulk in an identity-inferable way (indirect aggregate use, e.g. on real-estate platforms, is explicitly permitted by RVO). No cost. Access via a personal API key (https://epbdwebservices.rvo.nl/); the key is personal and must not be shared. Usage here: individual labels are used only as intermediate input to compute a derived, non-identifying per-building refurbishment score (refurbishment_state); no individual label data is stored, exported, or redistributed.

sources.title: CBS StatLine – Elektriciteitslevering aan woningen
sources.description: National electricity consumption per dwelling, by construction-year class, household-size class, and building type (detached/terraced house vs. apartment). Used, together with municipality-level dwelling occupancy, to estimate annual electricity demand per building.

sourceLicenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
sourceLicenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
sourceLicenses.instruction: Reuse of CBS website content is permitted provided CBS is cited as the source, unless a copyright exception applies to a specific part (e.g. a document).

sources.title: CBS / Klimaatmonitor – Wijken: warmtevoorzieningstechnologie
authors: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) / Klimaatmonitor
sources.description: Neighbourhood-level (wijk) shares of heating installation type (aardgas/blokverwarming/elektrisch zonder aardgasverbruik/onbekend). Used to heuristically assign a heating technology (gas/district_heat/hp) to every building.

sources.title: PDOK Bestuurlijke Gebieden – administrative boundaries (gemeente/provincie)

sources.description: Official municipality (gemeente, 2025) and neighbourhood (wijk, 2024) boundary geometries, used for the spatial joins that assign each building to a gemeente (refurbishment state, electricity demand) and wijk (heating technology).

resources.description: Per-building classification, TABULA construction period, individual refurbishment state, annual heat demand (existing/usual/advanced refurbishment), annual electricity demand, PV-relevant roof area by orientation, and heuristically assigned heating technology for all residential buildings in the Netherlands. Based on 3DBAG/BAG3D, BAG/VBO (Kadaster), TABULA typology, Klimaatmonitor insulation data, EP-Online (RVO) energy labels, and CBS (Statistics Netherlands) consumption and occupancy statistics.

contributors.title: Philippe Krienelke
contributors.comment: Created the Netherlands building-level energy simulation dataset.

description: Building-level dataset for all residential buildings in the Netherlands, providing per-building type classification, TABULA construction period, individual refurbishment state, annual heat demand (three refurbishment scenarios), annual electricity demand, PV-relevant roof area by orientation, and heuristically assigned heating technology.
